paras.en: A group of Labour MPs, among them Yvette Cooper, are bringing in the new year with a call to institute a UK "town of culture" award. The proposal is that it should sit alongside the existing city of culture title, which was held by Hull in 2017, and has been awarded to Coventry for 2021. Cooper and her colleagues argue that the success of the crown for Hull, where it brought in £220m of investment and an avalanche of arts, ought not to be confined to cities. Britain's towns, it is true, are not prevented from applying, but they generally lack the resources to put together a bid to beat their bigger competitors. A town of culture award could, it is argued, become an annual event, attracting funding and creating jobs.
paras.zh: 一群工党议员，其中包括伊薇特·库珀，在新年之际呼吁设立英国"文化城镇"奖。该提案建议它应与现有 的"文化之城"称号并列，后者在2017年由赫尔持有，并已授予考文垂2021年的称号。库珀及其同事认为, 赫尔获得这一桂冠取得的成功——为该地带来了2.2亿英镑的投资和大量艺术活动——不应仅限于城市。 诚然,英国的城镇并未被禁止申请,但它们通常缺乏资源来组织申请以击败更大的竞争对手。有人认为,"文化 城镇"奖可以成为一项年度活动,吸引资金并创造就业机会。

paras.en: It is also wise to recall that such titles are not a cure-all. A badly run "year of culture" washes in and washes out of a place like the tide, bringing prominence for a spell but leaving no lasting benefits to the community. The really successful holders of such titles are those that do a great deal more than fill hotel bedrooms and bring in high-profile arts events and good press for a year. They transform the aspirations of the people who live there; they nudge the self-image of the city into a bolder and more optimistic light. It is hard to get right, and requires a remarkable degree of vision, as well as cooperation between city authorities, the private sector, community groups and cultural organisations. But it can be done: Glasgow's year as European capital of culture can certainly be seen as one of a complex series of factors that have turned the city into the powerhouse of art, music and theatre that it remains today.
paras.zh: 明智的做法还在于记住,此类称号并非万能良药。运作不善的"文化年"会像潮水一样涌入又退出一个地方, 带来一时的知名度,但不会给社区留下持久的益处。此类称号真正成功的持有者,远不止填满酒店客房、引 入高规格艺术活动和一年的良好媒体报道。它们改变了当地居民的抱负;它们将城市的自我形象推向更大 胆、更乐观的方向。这很难做到,需要非凡的远见,以及城市当局、私营部门、社区团体和文化组织之间的 合作。但这是可以做到的:格拉斯哥作为欧洲文化之都的那一年,无疑可以被视为一系列复杂因素之一,这些 因素将这座城市转变为今天仍然保持的艺术、音乐和戏剧重镇。

questions.analysis:
26. Scientific publishing is seen as "a licence to print money" partly because____
[ A ] its funding has enjoyed a steady increase.
[ B ] its marketing strategy has been successful.
[ C ] its payment for peer review is reduced.
[ D ] its content acquisition costs nothing.

【判型】题干 Scientific publishing is seen as "a licence to print money" partly because____
指向原文某一条具体表述，不是要主旨、不是要态度、不是要推断，只要还原原文给出的
原因。
【拆句】Scientific publishing is seen as "a licence to print money" partly because____ 主干是
被动语态 is seen as，相当于「被视作……」；partly because 引出原因状语从句的空位，
正确项需是一个完整的从句内容，且只是「部分原因」之一。
【定位】Scientists need journals in which to publish their research, so they will supply the articles
without monetary reward.
科学家需要期刊来发表自己的研究，所以他们会无偿提供文章。
【选项】A)
无中生有
原文从未提及科学出版业「funding（拨款/资助）」在增加；它谈的是利润与售价。把
利润误读成「资助」属典型张冠李戴。
B)
偷换概念
原文谈的是利润率高 profit margins approaching 40%，并未把它归因于 marketing
strategy（营销策略）；高利润源于「内容免费 + 图书馆不敏感」，不是营销。
C)
与原文相反
原文说同行评审 also for free——是「零报酬」，不是「报酬被削减（reduced）」；
reduce 隐含「原本有、现在变少」，原文从未表明评审过去拿过钱。
D)
✓ 正确
they will supply the articles without monetary reward ↔its content acquisition costs nothing
Other scientists perform the specialised work of peer review also for free ↔
its content acquisition costs nothing
预判「内容来源不花钱」与 its content acquisition costs nothing 是同一意思的不同
说法，且题干 partly because 只要求给出一个原因——D 给出的正是定位句给出的核心
原因。

【定位】The Dutch giant Elsevier, which claims to publish 25% of the scientific papers produced in
the world, made profits of more than £900m last year, while UK universities alone spent more
than £210m in 2016 to enable researchers to access their own publicly funded research.
号称发表了全球 25% 科研论文的荷兰巨头爱思唯尔去年获利超过 9 亿英镑，而仅英国的大
学就在 2016 年花了 2.1 亿多英镑，让研究者去获取他们自己用公共资金完成的研究。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
UK universities alone spent more than £210m in 2016 to enable researchers to access their own
publicly funded research
↔thrived mainly on university libraries
Until this century, university libraries were not very price sensitive ↔
thrived mainly on university libraries
Elsevier 赚 9 亿、大学花 2.1 亿——这两个数字之间的因果对照就是「Elsevier 兴旺主
要靠大学图书馆」的最直接证据，A 项与预判完全一致。
B)
张冠李戴
原文 at a time when the rest of the publishing industry is in an existential crisis 说
的是「出版业的其他部分」陷入生存危机，正是用来反衬科学出版商利润优渥；Elsevier
不仅没陷入危机，反而是反例。
C)
过度推断
原文说 Elsevier 自身利润高，但从未说它「复兴了出版业」；恰恰相反，作者描绘的是
其他出版业陷入危机、而科学出版商独自暴利，二者是并存而非因果。
D)
与原文相反
原文清楚说明 UK universities alone spent more than £210m in 2016 to enable
researchers to access their own publicly funded research——是大学付钱给出版商
以接触本属自己资助的研究，而非出版商「慷慨资助研究者」。

【拆句】How does the author feel about the success of Sci-Hub? 一般疑问句结构 How does X
feel about Y；about 后的宾语是 the success of Sci-Hub，注意作者评价的是「Sci-Hub
的成功」这一现象，而非 Sci-Hub 本身的合法与否。
【定位】The success of Sci-Hub, which relies on researchers passing on copies they have themselves
legally accessed, shows the legal ecosystem has lost legitimacy among its users and must be
transformed so that it works for all participants.
Sci-Hub 的成功——它依赖研究者把自己合法获取的副本传出去——表明现行的合法生态
已经在用户中失去了合法性，必须被改造以服务所有参与方。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
relieved 意为「松一口气」，要求事情向好转的方向收尾；原文却说现行生态 has lost
legitimacy、必须被改造——情势恶化中，谈不上 relieved。
B)
无中生有
puzzled 意为「困惑、看不懂」，需要文本中出现「不明白/疑问」的信号；作者的论证
非常明确——他知道 Sci-Hub 为何出现、并主张体系必须改变，毫无困惑可言。
C)
✓ 正确
the legal ecosystem has lost legitimacy among its users and must be transformed ↔
Concerned
The most drastic, and thoroughly illegal, reaction has been the emergence of Sci-Hub ↔
Concerned
把段内 drastic / illegal / lost legitimacy / must be transformed 四处评价词合并看，
作者的态度极性是负向的忧虑——对应 Concerned 是唯一与预判极性一致的选项。
D)
偷换概念
encouraged 表「受到鼓舞」，意味着作者把 Sci-Hub 视为正面榜样；但原文用
drastic, and thoroughly illegal 给它打了负标签，作者只是借其成功反推体系失效，并
非为其欢呼。
从第5段和第6段可以得知,开放获取条款____
A) 给出版商留有一定的盈利空间。

【定位】More than half of all British scientific research is now published under open access terms:
either freely available from the moment of publication, or paywalled for a year or more so

如今英国超过一半的科研成果是按开放获取条款发表的：要么从发表那一刻起就免费可读，
要么先用付费墙挡上一年以上、让出版商先赚一笔，然后再普遍开放。

✓ 正确
paywalled for a year or more so that the publishers can make a profit before being placed on
general release
↔allow publishers some room to make money
Publishers have responded to the demand that they make their product free to readers by
charging their writers fees to cover the costs of preparing an article
↔allow publishers some room to make money
预判「保留盈利窗口」与 allow publishers some room to make money 的语义完全
一致，且 some 这种温和限定词与原文「先一年付费墙」「转向作者收费」的现实力度
相称，过强或过弱的选项都不及它。
B)
无中生有
原文从头到尾在谈费用与利润，没有任何句子说开放获取让科学家「发表
（publishing）」变得更容易；相反，科学家还要承担 fees 从 £500 to £5,000 不等，

与原文相反

反而稳步上涨且高于通胀，与 reduce substantially 完全相反。
D)
过度推断

[ A ] Trial subscription is offered.
[ B ] Labour triumphs over status.
[ C ] Costs are well controlled.
[ D ] The few feed on the many.

【判型】Which of the following characterizes the scientific publishing model? 问的是「哪一项
能概括这一模式」，答案须覆盖全文，是典型主旨题。
【拆句】Which of the following characterizes the scientific publishing model? 主语是 Which
of the following，谓语 characterizes 接宾语 the scientific publishing model；正确项作
为主语应能合理担任「概括者」的角色。
【选项】A)
无中生有
全文谈的是订阅费、利润、论文准备费等，未提及任何「trial subscription（试用订
阅）」机制；这是一个原文完全没有出现的商业概念。
B)
与原文相反
原文恰好相反：劳动是为了 the hope of status 而被免费付出——status 才是劳动的回

与原文相反
原文 the costs both of subscriptions and of these "article preparation costs" had
been steadily rising at a rate above inflation 明确成本上涨且超通胀，与 well
controlled（被良好控制）正面冲突。
D)
✓ 正确
labour is provided free in exchange for the hope of status, while huge profits are made by a few
big firms who run the market places
↔The few feed on the many
they will supply the articles without monetary reward ↔The few feed on the many
made profits of more than £900m last year ↔The few feed on the many
末段类比 huge profits are made by a few big firms vs labour is provided free 与
The few feed on the many 几乎是字面对应；同时 D 覆盖了全文五个区间共同的核心
结构——少数与多数之间的不对称依附。
S E N T E N C E I N S I G H T S · 句子精讲
10 句真题句逐层精讲
下列真题句各有独立的句子解析页——中文翻译、结构树逐层拆解、成分与时态、考点讲
解与真题高频词。点击句子进入完整解析。

Scientists need journals in which to publish their research, so they will supply the
articles without monetary reward.
第1段，第2句
"so" 连接的因果并列句在四六级和考研阅读中较为常见，"in which to do" 的定语结构也属于典型
书面语用法，掌握后有一定迁移价值。
With the content of papers secured for free, the publisher needs only find a market
for its journal.
第2段，第1句
句首 with 复合结构作状语是四六级和考研阅读中的常见句式，具有一定典型性。情态动词 need 直
接加动词原形的用法虽不如 need to do 常见，但在正式书面语中仍会出现。主谓宾加状语的基本
框架具有普遍性，学生掌握后可应用于理解类似结构的句子。
Until this century, university libraries were not very price sensitive.
第2段，第2句
主系表结构在考试中常见，时间状语前置也是典型用法，但整体过于简单，不涉及从句、并列、插
入语等考试高频句式，代表性中等偏低。
The Dutch giant Elsevier, which claims to publish 25% of the scientific papers
produced in the world, made profits of more than £900m last year, while UK
universities alone spent more than £210m in 2016 to enable researchers to access
their own publicly funded research; both figures seem to rise unstoppably despite
increasingly desperate efforts to change them.
第3段，第1句
本句包含非限制性定语从句补充背景、while 对比状语从句、分号连接两个独立主句形成递进总
结，这些都是四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式。分号用法和定语从句插入主干的结构尤其典型，掌
握后可迁移到大量真题长难句。

The most drastic, and thoroughly illegal, reaction has been the emergence of Sci-
Hub, a kind of global photocopier for scientific papers, set up in 2012, which now
claims to offer access to every paywalled article published since 2015.
第4段，第1句
这句结构训练价值高，典型性强，虽然时态本身不难，但主干遮挡和后置修饰层层展开很适合做结
构专项练习。若目标是提升长句拆解能力，这句值得优先训练。
More than half of all British scientific research is now published under open access
terms: either freely available from the moment of publication, or paywalled for a
year or more so that the publishers can make a profit before being placed on
general release.
第5段，第3句
被动语态主句加目的状语从句是四六级和考研真题中的高频结构,either ... or 并列也很常见。so
that 引导目的从句嵌套在并列结构中的用法在学术和新闻英语中经常出现,具有较强的代表性。掌
握本句结构后,学习者可以迁移到大量类似的复合句和并列句分析中,典型性较高。
Yet the new system has not yet worked out any cheaper for the universities.
第6段，第1句
简单句结构在考试中常见，现在完成时否定句也是典型考点。短语动词 work out 后接形容词表示
结果的用法较为地道，具有一定代表性，但因句式过于简单，迁移范围有限。
These range from around £500 to £5,000, and apparently the work gets more
expensive the more that publishers do it.
第6段，第3句
本句覆盖了主语、谓语、宾语、表语、状语等多种成分，且第二个主句中的 "the more ... the more
..." 比较结构是值得练习的典型易错点。第一个主句的介词短语状语和第二个主句的系表结构也有
一定训练价值，适合用于巩固基本成分划分和识别比较结构。

paras.en: With the use of eye-tracking technology, Julia Minson of the Harvard Kennedy School of Government concluded that eye contact can signal very different kinds of messages, depending on the situation. While eye contact may be a sign of connection or trust in friendly situations, it's more likely to be associated with dominance or intimidation in adversarial situations. "Whether you're a politician or a parent, it might be helpful to keep in mind that trying to maintain eye contact may backfire if you're trying to convince someone who has a different set of beliefs than you," said Minson.
paras.zh: 通过使用眼动追踪技术,哈佛大学肯尼迪政府学院的Julia Minson得出结论,眼神接触可以根据情境传递非 常不同类型的信息。虽然眼神接触在友好情境中可能是联系或信任的标志,但在对抗性情境中它更可能与支 配或威胁相关联。"无论你是政治家还是家长,记住如果你试图说服持有与你不同信念的人,试图保持眼神接 触可能会适得其反,这可能会有所帮助,"Minson说。

paras.en: When we look at a face or a picture, our eyes pause on one spot at a time, often on the eyes or mouth. These pauses typically occur at about three per second, and the eyes then jump to another spot, until several important points in the image are registered like a series of snapshots. How the whole image is then assembled and perceived is still a mystery although it is the subject of current research.
paras.zh: 当我们看一张脸或一幅图片时,我们的眼睛每次在一个点上停留,通常是在眼睛或嘴巴上。这些停留通常以 每秒约三次的频率发生,然后眼睛跳到另一个点,直到图像中的几个重要点像一系列快照一样被记录下来。 整个图像如何被组装和感知仍然是一个谜,尽管这是当前研究的主题。

paras.en: In people who score high in a test of neuroticism, a personality dimension associated with self- consciousness and anxiety, eye contact triggered more activity associated with avoidance, according to the Finnish researcher Jari Hietanen and colleagues. "Our findings indicate that people do not only feel different when they are the centre of attention but that their brain reactions also differ." A more direct finding is that people who scored highly for negative emotions like anxiety looked at others for shorter periods of time and reported more comfortable feelings when others did not look directly at them.

partC.analysis:
逐句解析
句前 (N) 即考卷划线句题号，与卷面下划线句一一对应——满分 10 分、每句约 2 分，阅卷把每句切成意群按采
分点给分（★ 为采分点意群）。
【来源】Age of Enlightenment: Discover the Philosophical Movement That Triggered
Innovation, Revolution and Change 第一章 Background中的第二节 Dare to Know:
Explore the Enlightenment came to be的开头部分。
【主旨】文艺复兴催生理性时代，教会权威让位于科学与理性
全篇是一条思想史时间线：文艺复兴的创造力让世界 turned from God and the authority of the
Roman Catholic Church，转向更人文、更讲逻辑的态度；接着哥白尼、开普勒、伽利略用科学冲
击教会，最终 the Renaissance was over and it was time for a new era—the Age of Reason。
作者态度是肯定理性、科学的进步，对教会的压制持批判倾向。这条「教会权威衰落、理性崛起」
的基调，是判断全篇褒贬词（如把 eclipse、suppress 往『压制/遮蔽』译）的语境底座。
(48)Despite attempts by the Church to suppress this new generation of logicians and rationalists,
more explanations for how the universe functioned were being made at a rate that the people could no
longer ignore.
(49)As many took on the duty of trying to integrate reasoning and scientific philosophies into
the world, the Renaissance was over and it was time for a new era—the Age of Reason.
(50)Such actions to seek knowledge and to understand what information we
already knew were captured by the Latin phrase 'sapere aude' or 'dare to know',

【指代】第47句 their / each of their revelations 指代谁
句中 their 不在本句内部，必须回上一句还原：the great minds of Nicolaus Copernicus,
Johannes Kepler and Galileo Galilei demonstrated the power of scientific study and
discovery。所以 their revelations 指『哥白尼、开普勒、伽利略这几位伟大人物的发现/揭示』。
孤立翻这句会把 their 译丢或译错。
第48句 this new generation of logicians and rationalists 指代谁
this 承接上文整条线索：被教会打压的正是第2、3段讲的那批以哥白尼等人为代表的科学家与理性
思考者。结合 a new kind of philosophy founded in reason was born 可知 this new
generation 指『这一代新兴的逻辑学家和理性主义者』，译时把 this 落实为『这一代』即可，不
必再绕回人名。
全篇术语统一译法：Renaissance / Age of Reason / rationalists
Renaissance 全篇统一译『文艺复兴』；the Age of Reason 译『理性时代』；rationalists 与
reason、reasoning 同根，统一往『理性』靠（理性主义者/理性/推理），避免一会儿译『合理』
一会儿译『理智』造成术语漂移。
(46) with the Church's teachings and ways of thinking eclipsed by the Renaissance, the gap
between the Medieval and modern periods had been bridged leading to new and unexplored
intellectual territories.
【意群】with the Church's teachings and ways of thinking eclipsed by the Renaissance,（with 引导的独
立主格作状语）★采分→随着教会的教义与思维方式被文艺复兴所遮蔽，
难点：eclipse 熟词僻义＋with 状语结构
eclipse 名词义是『日/月食』，此处作动词是僻义『使黯然失色、遮蔽、盖过』，结合主旨 It
turned from God and the authority of the Roman Catholic Church 应取『被遮蔽/被盖过/
黯然失色』。整块是 with + 名词 + 过去分词 的独立主格，表伴随背景，译成『随着……
被……』即可。
the gap between the Medieval and modern periods had been bridged（主句（被动））★采分→
中世纪与现代之间的鸿沟已被弥合
难点：bridge 名→动＋被动汉化
bridge 此处是动词『弥合、架起桥梁、衔接』，had been bridged 是过去完成被动。被动直译
『被弥合』略生硬，可保留『被弥合』或转无主句『弥合了……鸿沟』。Medieval 译『中世
纪』，与 modern『现代』对照。
leading to new and unexplored intellectual territories.（现在分词作结果状语）★采分→通向崭新
而未经探索的知识领域。
难点：intellectual territories 抽象名词具体化
lead to 『导向、通往』；territories 本义『领土』，与 intellectual 搭配是比喻义『（知识/智
识的）领域、疆域』。unexplored『未被探索的』。整块译『从而通向崭新而未经探索的知识/
思想领域』，把抽象的『智识疆域』具体化为『知识领域』更通顺。

【调序】with 状语提前、被动转『已』字句
汉语习惯把背景状语放句首，所以 with the Church's teachings and ways of thinking eclipsed
by the Renaissance 这段『随着……』直接领起全句；主句 had been bridged 的被动用『已被弥
合』或转主动『弥合了』；句尾 leading to 的结果状语顺势接『从而通向……』。整体顺序与英文
基本一致，只需把被动柔化。
【译文】随着教会的教义与思维方式被文艺复兴所遮蔽，中世纪与现代之间的鸿沟得以弥合，
从而通向崭新而未经探索的知识领域。
(47) Before each of their revelations, many thinkers at the time had sustained more ancient ways of
thinking, including the geocentric view that the Earth was at the centre of our universe.
【意群】Before each of their revelations,（时间状语）★采分→在他们各自的发现/揭示之前，
难点：their 跨句回指＋revelation 取义
their 句内无先行词，须回上句还原：指 Nicolaus Copernicus, Johannes Kepler and Galileo
Galilei 这三位。revelation 本义带宗教色彩『启示』，此处语境是科学发现，取『发现/揭示/重
大发现』。译时可点明为『在哥白尼等人各自做出这些发现之前』，把 their 还原。
many thinkers at the time had sustained more ancient ways of thinking,（主句（过去完成））★
采分→当时许多思想家一直沿袭着更为古老的思维方式，
难点：sustain 熟词僻义
sustain 常见义『维持、支撑、遭受』，此处宾语是 ways of thinking，取『坚持、沿袭、保
持』。had sustained 过去完成表『此前一直……』。more ancient『更古老的』，more 是比
较级修饰，译『更为古老』。
including the geocentric view that the Earth was at the centre of our universe.（including 介词
短语＋that 同位语从句）★采分→包括地球处于宇宙中心的地心说观点。
难点：geocentric 术语＋that 同位语从句
geocentric view『地心说/地心观』（geo-地+centric 中心）。关键：that the Earth was at
the centre... 不是定语从句，而是 view 的同位语从句（that 后是完整句、解释 view 的内
容），译成『……这一观点』，把 that 从句内容前置到 view 之前作其内容。
【调序】同位语从句前置作 view 的内容
geocentric view that... 中，that 从句是 view 的内容，按汉语习惯把内容提到『观点』前面：
『地球处于宇宙中心的地心说观点』。其余顺序（时间状语在前、主干居中、举例在后）与中文一
致，无需大动。
【译文】在哥白尼等人各自做出这些发现之前，当时许多思想家一直沿袭着更为古老的思维方
式，其中就包括认为地球处于宇宙中心的地心说观点。

(48) Despite attempts by the Church to suppress this new generation of logicians and rationalists,
more explanations for how the universe functioned were being made at a rate that the people could
no longer ignore.
【意群】Despite attempts by the Church to suppress this new generation of logicians and rationalists,
（Despite 引导的让步状语）★采分→尽管教会试图压制这一代新兴的逻辑学家和理性主义者，
难点：Despite 让步＋this 跨句回指＋名词化 attempts
Despite『尽管』引导让步。attempts...to suppress 是名词化结构，译时还原成动作『试图压
制』更顺。this new generation 的 this 承上文，指第2、3段被教会迫害的那批科学家/理性思
考者，落实为『这一代新兴的……』即可。logicians 逻辑学家、rationalists 理性主义者。
more explanations for how the universe functioned were being made（主句（过去进行被动））
★采分→越来越多关于宇宙如何运行的解释正被不断提出，
难点：were being made 进行被动＋how 从句作定语
were being made 是过去进行被动『正在被做出/提出』，译时宜转主动或无主句『（人们）不
断提出』。for how the universe functioned 是介词 for + how 引导的名词性从句，作
explanations 的定语，译『关于宇宙如何运行的（解释）』前置。function 此处是动词『运
行、运转』。
at a rate that the people could no longer ignore.（方式状语＋that 定语从句）★采分→其速度之
快是人们再也无法忽视的。
难点：at a rate that... 定语从句＋程度含义
at a rate『以一种……的速度/势头』，that 引导定语从句修饰 rate（that 后 ignore 缺宾语，故
为定语从句）。直译『以一种人们无法再忽视的速度』偏翻译腔，可拆译为『其势头/速度之
快，人们再也无法忽视』，把后置定语转成一个小分句。no longer『不再、再也不』。
【调序】让步前置＋定语从句后拆分句
Despite 让步状语提到句首『尽管……』；主句被动转主动『（人们）不断提出越来越多……解
释』；句尾 at a rate that the people could no longer ignore 的较长定语从句，不前置成『以
一种人们无法忽视的速度』（生硬），改后置拆成小分句『其势头之快，人们再也无法忽视』。
【译文】尽管教会试图压制这一代新兴的逻辑学家和理性主义者，但关于宇宙如何运行的解释
仍被不断提出，其势头之快，人们再也无法忽视。

(49) As many took on the duty of trying to integrate reasoning and scientific philosophies into the
world, the Renaissance was over and it was time for a new era—the Age of Reason.
【意群】As many took on the duty of trying to integrate reasoning and scientific philosophies into the
world,（As 引导的时间/原因状语从句）★采分→随着许多人担起将理性与科学哲学融入世界的
责任，
难点：As 多义＋many 名词性＋take on/integrate 搭配
As 此处取『随着、当……时』（表伴随/时间），不是『因为』也不是『像』。many 单独作主
语＝『许多人』（承上文那批理性思考者）。take on the duty『承担/担起责任』，integrate
A into B『把 A 融入 B』。reasoning 译『推理/理性思维』，与全文 reason 术语呼应。
the Renaissance was over（并列主句一）★采分→文艺复兴结束了，
难点：be over 短语
be over『结束、终结』，是固定搭配而非『在……上方』。Renaissance 与全文统一译『文艺复
兴』。此块直白，仅提示别把 over 当方位词。
and it was time for a new era—the Age of Reason.（并列主句二＋破折号同位）★采分→新时代
到来了——理性时代。
难点：it was time for 句型＋破折号同位语
it was time for...『是……的时候了/……到来了』，it 是形式主语，不必译出。破折号后 the Age
of Reason 是 a new era 的同位语（破折号常引出解释/同位），译时保留破折号或用『即』：
『一个新时代——理性时代』。

写作无唯一标准答案，以下为达标示范
Notice
To enrich campus life and celebrate cultural diversity, the Students Union is delighted to announce a singing
contest specially for international students on our campus.
The contest will be held in the Main Auditorium at 7 p.m. on December 15th. Participants may perform any

Those interested are welcome to sign up by emailing your name and song title to su@campus.edu before

We warmly invite all international students to take part and share your wonderful voices with us!
Students Union December 1st

通知

A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意
这道题到底要写什么、立意是什么
动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些
是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。
核心任务
以学生会名义发通知告知歌唱赛
本题要写的是一则通知，交际目的一句话钉死：代表学校学生会，向国际学生发布一场即将举
办的歌唱比赛的消息并邀请其参加——即 inform the international students about an
upcoming singing contest。体裁是通知（White a notice in about 100 words，注意原题 White
是 Write 的笔误，仍指"写一则通知"），不是书信、不是议论文。

读者 · 语域
校学生会对国际学生·正式友好
身份是校学生会（写作要求里 The Students Union of your university），读者是 the
international students（本校国际学生）。这决定了三点语域走向：一是称呼与语气要正式但
友好（公告性质，非私聊）；二是署名必须用机构名 Students Union；三是题目硬性规定 Do
not use your own name in the notice，落款绝不能出现自己真名——这是本题最扎眼的禁令，
先记死。
中心立意
让国际学生知道并来参赛
本篇的交际目的：让每一位国际学生读完就明白"有这么一场歌唱比赛、什么时候在哪、怎么报
名、找谁、欢迎我去"——即把 an upcoming singing contest 的关键信息一次交代清楚并发出
邀请。

1. 发布目的
开门见山说明：学生会现向国际学生宣布将举办一场歌唱比赛（对应 inform the international

2. 比赛信息

主题"）。
3. 报名方式与联系人
交代 how to sign up 与 whom to contact：报名渠道（邮箱）、截止日期，以及咨询用的联系
人和电话。
4. 发出邀请
结尾一句诚挚邀请，欢迎全体国际学生踊跃参加，呼应读者身份、收束全文。

英语一真题(2020)
Directions:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the picture below. In your essay, you should
1)describe the picture briefly,
2)interpret the implied meaning, and
3)give your comments.
You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET. (20 points)

【参考范文 · 194 词】
写作无唯一标准答案，以下为达标示范
As is depicted in the drawing entitled "Habit", two contrasting figures are presented. On the left, a woman sits
at a desk piled with documents, bending over her work, with a bubble above her reading that she feels at ease
only when tasks are finished early. On the right, a man leans back in his chair with only a book and a pen
before him, looking relaxed, saying that he never starts until the last moment.
Simple as it seems, the picture conveys a thought-provoking message about the power of habits. The two
attitudes stand for two life styles: one embraces planning ahead and finishing early, while the other keeps
putting things off until deadlines loom. What the cartoonist intends to highlight is that a good habit of getting
things done in advance keeps us calm and efficient, whereas procrastination leaves us anxious and passive
when time runs out.
In my view, we should cultivate the good habit of acting early rather than delaying. Therefore, it is advisable
to make a plan and start at once. Only in this way can we stay in control of our time and lead a more
productive life.
【参考译文】

如画中题为「习惯」的漫画所示，画面呈现出两个形成对比的人物。左侧，一位女性坐在堆满文件的办公
桌前，低头伏案，她上方的对话框写着：只有尽早完成任务，她才感到安心。右侧，一位男性靠在椅背
上，桌上只有一本书和一支笔，看上去很放松，他说自己不到最后一刻绝不动手。
看似简单，这幅漫画却传达出一个发人深省的信息，关乎习惯的力量。两种态度代表两种生活方式：一种
崇尚提前规划、尽早完成，另一种则一拖再拖，直到期限逼近。画家意在强调：提前把事情做完的好习惯
让我们从容而高效，而拖延则让我们在时间耗尽时焦虑又被动。
在我看来，我们应当培养尽早行动而非拖延的好习惯。因此，明智之举是制定计划、立即着手。唯有如
此，我们才能掌控自己的时间，过上更高效的生活。
【第 1 段】客观分述左右。本段用「As is depicted ... two contrasting figures are presented」总起点
出对比，再以 On the left / On the right 分述两人动作，并把对话框转为间接引语（reading that ... /
saying that ...），全用现在时客观陈述，落实描述段功能，对应 describe the picture briefly。
【第 2 段】抽象出寓意。本段以「Simple as it seems, the picture conveys a ... message」把镜头从画
面拉向道理，用「The two attitudes stand for two life styles」把人物抽象成两类，再以「What the
cartoonist intends to highlight is that ...」点明习惯决定状态，是采分核心，对应 interpret the
implied meaning。
【第 3 段】表态并给建议。本段以「In my view, we should ... rather than ...」亮明支持早做，用
「Therefore, it is advisable to ...」给出制定计划、立刻着手的建议，末句「Only in this way can we
...」倒装拔高收尾并回扣寓意，对应 give your comments。
A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意
这道题到底要写什么、立意是什么
动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域、读懂配图 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要
点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。
核心任务
看图三段：描述＋寓意＋评论
本题要求 Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the picture below，即根据漫画写一篇小
短文，依次完成 describe the picture briefly（简述画面）、interpret the implied meaning（阐
释寓意）、give your comments（发表评论）三件事。这不是抒情散文，是有固定采分点的议
论小短文。

读者 · 语域
面向阅卷人的正式书面语
本题无具体收信人、无身份设定，也不需要称呼和落款，只需面向阅卷人写规范的正式书面英
语：用第三人称客观描述画面，评论段可用第一人称表态。不要写成书信或口语，别用缩写和
网络词。
配图要读出
同题两人：早做 vs 拖延
配图是 标题为“习惯”的漫画，左右对比：左侧 一位女性坐在办公桌前，桌上堆满了文件，对话
框写 尽早完成，才放心；右侧 一位男性坐在办公桌前，桌上只有一本书和一支笔，靠在椅背
上很放松，对话框写 不到最后，不动手。同一标题「习惯」下，一个未雨绸缪、一个临时抱佛
脚——可写点就是两种习惯的对照及其后果。
中心立意
养成提前完成的好习惯
中心论点：一个人应养成 尽早完成，才放心 式提前行动的好习惯，摒弃 不到最后，不动手 的
拖延，因为前者带来从容与高效，后者只留下焦虑与被动。
要展开的要点
1. 描述点：两种态度的画面
客观交代漫画两侧：勤勉早做的女性 vs 靠椅放松、拖到最后的男性，以及各自对话框里的话，
为后文寓意作铺垫。
2. 寓意点：习惯决定状态
由画中两人推出生活道理：提前规划的习惯让人计划内从容，拖延的习惯让人在期限逼近时焦
虑被动——习惯不同，人生状态不同。
3. 评论点：表态＋建议
明确支持提前行动，并给出可操作建议：制定计划、立刻着手，尤其对学生和年轻人，以此掌
控时间、提升效率。
